stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “During online class, some students turned their cameras on, while others kept them off.”?
options: Their teacher said it was a simple lesson: when things look the same on the outside, names can save lunch.
Choosing the song taught the class that disagreement is not always a wall.

Online learning taught the teacher that participation does not always look the same.
